description: A consumer pauses while the child produces progress observations.
requiredBehavior: Outbound memory never exceeds 64 ordinary frames or 4 MiB encoded payload, with at most one frame at 1 MiB.
Producer backpressure is bounded; progress may be coalesced and the next observation reports skipped sequence range/count.
Request receipts, cancellation state and terminal result are not silently dropped; terminal has its reserved capacity.
If the peer never drains the stream, stop admission, cancel the root and bound cleanup; missing terminal at process death is uncertain.
